proposed_mechanism: Cash-open mean reversion, session-flat: at the equity-index cash open the first impulse frequently over-extends (inventory imbalance / stop runs) and, when the breakout fails on the same H1 bar, price reverts toward the opening-range midpoint within the session. Trade only that failed side, flat before rollover, with a hard daily loss breaker - complementing H-CW's continuation side of the same opening range.
